name: Gatekeeper Initiate
description: +2 save vs. aberrations' supernatural/spell-like abilities. Adds Knowledge (the planes) as a druid class skill (already true for Lyra via Planar Shepherd). Grants 9 spells castable as druid spells at set levels (1st protection from evil through 9th imprisonment). Not modeled — no existing effect type covers a conditional save bonus or a per-level granted-spell-list addition.
